task: Create an executable Node.js script that rebuilds the saved ChatGPT shared-page HTML while changing only boolean true values belonging to three exact serialized conversation metadata keys to false.

source_structure.transport: React Router streamController.enqueue string containing a flattened JSON array
source_structure.main_payload_selection: first decoded enqueue string whose trimmed form starts with '['
source_structure.important_flattening_fact: Property names may be deduplicated strings referenced by object keys like _<index>, and boolean values may also be shared slots. Do not mutate a globally shared true slot if unrelated properties reference it; retarget only selected properties to a false slot (existing or newly appended).

requirements: Accept input HTML path and output HTML path as CLI arguments.
Locate and decode the main streamController.enqueue JSON-string argument without executing arbitrary page JavaScript.
Identify each object property whose decoded property-name string is exactly one of the three target keys.
If that property's referenced semantic value is boolean true, change only that property to semantic false.
Do not globally replace true literals or mutate a shared true slot used by unrelated properties.
Re-serialize the changed main payload back into the original enqueue call while preserving the remainder of the HTML byte-for-byte where possible.
Fail loudly when the expected stream payload or target keys are absent.
Print a JSON summary containing per-key changed counts and input/output paths.
validation_expectations: All source target-key true values become false.
The non-boolean hide_all reasoning marker remains unchanged.
The rebuilt HTML is accepted by the existing extract-shared-chat.js mechanism.
